scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test:browser: npm --prefix frontend run build && node tests/browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix frontend run build -- --emptyOutDir=false
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t seadex-companion:test . && node tests/docker-smoke.mjs seadex-companion:test
